question: Western ghats are locally known as ______ in Maharashtra.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sahyadri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Western Ghat is known as Sahyadri ____Mountain__ in Maharashtra, Goa & Karnataka.
 
• The Western Ghat has a high altitudinal variation and the average elevation is 1200m.
 
• Sahyadri mountain range or the Western Ghat originates near the town of Nasik in Maharashtra.
 
• It runs parallel to the coast and merges with the Nilgiri hills complex of Tamil Nadu in the south.
 
• These Hills cover 1600 Km and form the catchment area for the complex river drainage system. 
 
• Nilgiri Hills is located in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka state.
 
• Nilgiri Hills meet at the junction of Western Ghats & Eastern Ghat.
 
• Doddabetta is the highest peak in the Nilgiri Hills at 2637m.
 
• Anaimudi is the highest mountain peak of southern India located in the Anaimalai Hills at 2695m.
